facility.name: Lil' Angels Childcare & Learning Academy
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Before School Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Drop-In Care,Part Time Care,Transportation to/from School ,Field Trips

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 8703 ANTOINE DR, HOUSTON, TX, 77088

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Related to Planned Activities: During the walk-through, CCR observed school-age children watching YouTube on television, which did not meet educational goals, as well as children playing video games on their phones and tablets.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Related to Planned Activities (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(1))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: CCR observed that the chain link at the bottom edge of the playground fence was sticking out and curled, creating a hazard.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912): Three new hire caregivers did not complete the 2912 Pre-Employment Affidavit. Correction made: The caregivers have now completed the Affidavit form and placed it in their files.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912) (26 TAC §746.901(5))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Based on the evidence obtained during the investigation, it was substantiated that a caregiver demonstrated poor judgment by utilizing aggressive language and hostile body language toward a child as a method of redirection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Release Information: CCR observed that a child's file was missing the contact information for the authorized release person.    Correction made:The parent has provided the contact information for the authorized release person.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Release Information (26 TAC §746.605(7))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: The Consumer Product Safety Commission form has not been completed since 2023.    Correction made: The director conducted a walk-through of the operation using the recall list, completed the Consumer Product Safety Commission form, and posted it as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §746.4135(b))

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: CCR observed that the acoustic ceiling tiles in the toddler classroom appeared to be sagging.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Playground Maintenance Records: Playground maintenance checklists was not provided during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Playground Maintenance Records (26 TAC §746.801(8))

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: CCR did not observe a food allergy plan that was diagnosed by a healthcare professional.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: CCR observed multiple nails on the floor in the Pre-K classroom.    Correction made: The director removed the nails from the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: A review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2025 data from January 20, 2026, revealed that the center had not reported the number of employees who left employment in 2025 by January 15, 2026, as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The operation playground fence is broken and has missing picket.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional: Two infants do not have a written feeding instruction for the month of June and July.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §746.2421(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Employees' Attendance: The director time sheets were not available during the inspection.  The second director time sheet for the month of June were not available during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Employees' Attendance (26 TAC §746.801(5))

occurrences.finding: Incident/Illness Report Form Storage: An incident report was not available during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Incident/Illness Report Form Storage (26 TAC §746.709)

occurrences.finding: Parent right to file a complaint: Based on the evidence obtained during the investigation, there is sufficient evidence to support that a parent?s right?s to file a complaint was bribed to avoid an investigation inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parent right to file a complaint (26 TAC §746.521(2))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: A caregiver made a poor judgment by holding a child's nose while cleaning it, resulting leaving a bruise.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: People Whose Behavior/Health Threatens Children Not Present: Based on the evidence obtained during the investigation, there is sufficient evidence to support the operation allowed a parent in a classroom with an endangering behavior while children were in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: People Whose Behavior/Health Threatens Children Not Present (26 TAC §746.3703(a))

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: Based on the documentation and information gathered during the investigation, there is sufficient evidence to support that the operation did not report an incident to licensing within the timeframe.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Complying with Laws and Rules: Based on the evidence obtained during the investigation, there is sufficient evidence to support the owner/director made a judgement call to hold a meeting in the classroom while parents' behavior escalated, without relocating to a private space away from the children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Complying with Laws and Rules (26 TAC §746.201(9))

occurrences.finding: AP Safety Precautions for Loading and Unloading Children - No Child Unattended: Based on the documentation and information gathered during the investigation, there is sufficient evidence to support that a child was left in the operation vehicle unattended.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Safety Precautions for Loading and Unloading Children - No Child Unattended (26 TAC §746.5605(4))

occurrences.finding: Medication No Longer Used: During the inspection investigation, CCR observed four empty medications that are no longer used in the operation medication box.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Medication No Longer Used (26 TAC §746.3809)

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: Based on the documentation and information gathered during the investigation, there is sufficient evidence to support that the operation did not make a report to licensing within the timeframe.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less: The loose-fill is less than six inches on both of the outside playground areas.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization: One of the children's files were missing an emergency medical authorization.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement (26 TAC §746.605(12))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional: The feeding sheets on hand are not updated for the current or past month.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §746.2421(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Date of Admission: Three of the children's files were missing the date of admission.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Date of Admission (26 TAC §746.605(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: Six of the children's files were missing an emergency contact address.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Water Activity Permission: Ten of the children's files were missing the swim without assistance notification.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Physician Information (26 TAC §746.605(10))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: Four of the children's files were missing updated immunization records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children: Cleaning supplies were within reach of children in the restroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: Three of the children's files were missing health statements.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device: A 9 month old was observed sleeping in a rocker.      This was corrected when the infant was placed in a crib.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2426)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Based off the video footage of the incident, the caregiver didn?t show self-control during the altercation with a child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Policies for Release of Children - Record Identity of Person: Base off the information obtained from the investigation it was determined the operation did not have a record of the Identity of someone who a child was release to.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Policies for Release of Children - Record Identity of Person (26 TAC §746.4103(b))

occurrences.finding: Policies for Release of Children: The center does not have a written  policy in place for the release of children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Policies for Release of Children (26 TAC §746.4103(a))
